about: [O6b] The havoc, after the critic (brief O6b section 3; the cold play's blocker: 'ram every car on Grand Ave until each is a wreck' could not be won). ?start=smash.ten by the critic's own medium hands (tools/plays/critic/o6b/ram_bot.mjs, not the owner's driver): E into my coupe, point at the next parked car and floor it (about 40 km/h at most, a 9 m run-up), back off, again, up to six blows a car, the ten in the critic's order; my car spent (smoking, on a hub, burning): E out, walk to the next car I can take (the spares by the start, the coupe, the lorries), E in. The check counts WRECKS, not states: at least nine of the ten parked cars burnt out (the tenth may still be burning or smoking when the hands run out), and everything that came off at rest on the road, none floating, none in a wall, every door lying on its face. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o6b_ram.json

steps.label: the ten rammed by medium hands (no fail: out of every burning car in time)

steps.eval: JSON.stringify(G.city.cars.map((c, i) => [i, c.kind, +c.damage.toFixed(2), c.smashD && c.smashD.state, c.spare ? 'spare' : '']))

steps.name: at least nine of the ten parked cars wrecks by ramming (and the blasts' chain)

steps.eval: (() => { const S = G.stage.smash, st = G.stage; const P = S.out.filter((i) => i.part); const R = { n: P.length, kinds: {}, live: 0, floating: [], inWall: [], edge: [] }; for (const it of P) { R.kinds[it.kind] = (R.kinds[it.kind] || 0) + 1; if (it.state === 'live') R.live++; const b = it.body; if (!b) continue; let low = Infinity; for (const sx of [-1, 1]) for (const sy of [-1, 1]) for (const sz of [-1, 1]) { const r = new N.THREE.Vector3(sx * b.e.x, sy * b.e.y, sz * b.e.z).applyQuaternion(it.Q); const y = b.p.y + r.y - st.surfaceY(b.p.x + r.x, b.p.z + r.z); if (y < low) low = y; } if (it.state === 'rest' && low > 0.06) R.floating.push([it.kind, +low.toFixed(2)]); if (it.state === 'rest' && it.kind === 'cardoor' && Math.abs(new N.THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1).applyQuaternion(it.Q).y) < 0.9) R.edge.push([+b.p.x.toFixed(1), +b.p.z.toFixed(1)]); for (const o of st.colliders.near(b.p.x, b.p.z, 1)) { if (o.gone || o === it.lie || o.r != null || o.tag !== 'wall') continue; const dx = b.p.x - o.cx, dz = b.p.z - o.cz; const lx = dx * o.c - dz * o.s, lz = dx * o.s + dz * o.c; if (Math.abs(lx) < o.hx - 0.1 && Math.abs(lz) < o.hz - 0.1) R.inWall.push([it.kind, +b.p.x.toFixed(1), +b.p.z.toFixed(1)]); } } window.__o6bParts = R; return JSON.stringify(R); })()

steps.name: every part off at rest: none floating, none in a wall, no door on its edge
